text:
acme-inc-support: Hi — since ~09:30 UTC we started seeing intermittent 502 / 504 responses from the hosted inference endpoint. High failure rate during client bursts, many of our SDK clients then retry and we see duplicate charges. Example trace id: tr-7a9c. Concurrency was ~120rps from our side. Any immediate workarounds?

amira: Sorry about that — we're investigating now. Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and confirm which model and region?

acme-inc-support: Here's one failing curl we captured (redacted API key):

```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"open-llama-7b","input":"hello"}'
```

Response: 502 Bad Gateway, body: `\{"error\":\"upstream error\", \"trace\":\"tr-7a9c\"}`

devon: I can see the same trace in ingress logs — p95 downstream latency spiked right before the 502s. Opening infra investigation now. @luke any early ideas from edge side?

sre-bot: ALERT: edge-pool-usw2 connection_queue_len=75 (>70) for 12m; upstream-inflight-queueing spikes detected.

luke: Reproduced locally by replaying ACME's traffic shape (120rps short bursts). When concurrency >~80 we occasionally get upstream 504/inflight_queue_timeout from the runtime. Logs show kvcache lock waits and then gateway 502. Snippet from runtime logs:

```
[2026-03-17T09:31:12Z] runtime: inflight_queue_timeout id=tr-7a9c upstream=embedder-12 timeout_ms=2000 reason="kvcache-lock"
[2026-03-17T09:31:12Z] proxy: returning 502 to client id=tr-7a9c
```

devon: Sounds like KV cache contention + bursty load is causing requests to queue and hit gateway timeouts. Two immediate mitigations: 1) throttle client concurrency on the SDK side (cap to ~60-70) and 2) switch SDK to exponential backoff with jitter to avoid thundering herd. We'll also try a runtime hotfix.

amira: I've messaged the customer recommending a temporary cap and provided a sample SDK change.

acme-inc-support: We applied a client-side cap to 60 and enabled exponential backoff with jitter. Errors dropped significantly but we're still seeing ~0.8% 502s during peak bursts. Can you share ETA for the runtime fix? Billing impact: multiple retries caused duplicated invoice lines for the 09:30–09:45 window. We need a credit.

devon: Understood on billing — we'll reconcile and apply credits for that window. On runtime: engineering identified a low-latency fix that increases inflight-queue capacity and reduces kvcache lock hold time. Patch merged to main; deploying to canary in us-west-2 now. ETA for canary -> global roll is ~45 minutes if metrics look good.

luke: Canary deploy started at 09:52 UTC in us-west-2. Monitoring agent: error rate and queue length for the canary nodes.

sre-bot: METRIC: canary-usw2 error_rate(5m)=0.9% -> 0.4% after image pull; connection_queue_len dropping from 72 -> 18.

devon: Preliminary numbers look promising. We'll keep canary for 30–60m and then do a gradual rollout. If things are green we'll push global.

amira: Sent customer update: hotfix deployed to canary, asked them to keep the client cap in place for 1 hour, and confirmed we will credit duplicated charges.

acme-inc-support: Thanks — appreciate the update. Please confirm when global rollout completes.

luke: Post-canary: error rate on canary nodes down from 7.8% -> 0.6% (5m). Starting gradual rollout to remaining us-west clusters at 10:20 UTC.

sre-bot: DEPLOY: rollout step 1/6 to us-west-1 started. No elevated error rates observed in first step.

devon: Rollout completed at 10:47 UTC. Global error rates back to baseline. We'll keep extra monitoring for 2 hours.

amira: Confirmed with billing — credits will be issued for impacted window and you'll get a support ticket number shortly. Follow-up: we'll add a recommended SDK pattern to the docs to avoid immediate retry storms (cap concurrency + jittered backoff).

acme-inc-support: Confirming errors are gone on our end. Very grateful for the quick triage and credit offer :heart:

amira: Glad that helped. Actions captured: (1) billing credit for 09:30–09:45 window, (2) add SDK guidance to docs, (3) monitoring alert tuning to catch early kvcache lock signals. Closing thread after 2h warm window if stable. :thumbsup:
